% titlesec/titletoc before hyperref; cleveref after hyperref.
\usepackage{styles/chapters}
\usepackage{styles/frontmatter}

\usepackage{listings}
\lstset{
  basicstyle=\ttfamily\mdseries\small,
  keywordstyle=\mdseries,
  breaklines=true,
  frame=single,
  columns=fullflexible,
  rulecolor=\color{rule}
}

\usepackage{hyperref}
\hypersetup{
  colorlinks=true,
  linkcolor=accent,
  citecolor=accent,
  urlcolor=accent,
  filecolor=accent,
  bookmarksnumbered=true,
  pdftitle={\ThesisTitleShort},
  pdfauthor={\ThesisAuthor}
}
\pdfstringdefDisableCommands{%
  \def\rightarrow{->}%
  \def\texttt#1{#1}%
  \def\emph#1{#1}%
  \def\textit#1{#1}%
  \def\textbf#1{#1}%
  \def\textcolor#1#2{#2}%
  \def\footcite#1{}%
  \def\textcite#1{}%
  \def\cite#1{}%
  \def\parencite#1{}%
  \def\Todo#1{}%
  \def\term#1{#1}%
  \def\idaTermHead#1{#1}%
  \def\idaTermBack#1{}%
}

\usepackage[nameinlink]{cleveref}
\crefname{chapter}{rozdz.}{rozdz.}
\Crefname{chapter}{Rozdział}{Rozdziały}
\crefname{section}{podrozdz.}{podrozdz.}
\Crefname{section}{Podrozdział}{Podrozdziały}
\crefname{figure}{ryc.}{ryc.}
\Crefname{figure}{Rycina}{Ryciny}
\crefname{table}{tab.}{tab.}
\Crefname{table}{Tabela}{Tabele}
\crefname{appendix}{zał.}{zał.}
\Crefname{appendix}{Załącznik}{Załączniki}
\crefname{equation}{równ.}{równ.}
\Crefname{equation}{Równanie}{Równania}

\usepackage[
  backend=biber,
  citestyle=verbose-trad2,
  bibstyle=authortitle,
  sorting=nyt,
  autocite=footnote,
  hyperref=true,
  backref=true,
  backrefstyle=three,
  maxbibnames=99,
  doi=true,
  url=true,
  isbn=false,
  giveninits=true,
  uniquename=init
]{biblatex}
\addbibresource{bibliography/references.bib}
